notes.title: Objectives and Tips for Exit Doors coming
notes.content:
[h1]Exit Doors has a redesigned Objective and Tips system[/h1]

We desided to redesign the whole objective and tips system. And here are the results. The idea is to have objectives and enable all of them with two tips. Player can have a new tip after waiting for some time. In Options you can choose if they come all, in 15 seconds, in 30 seconds or in a minute.

This feature will be in the next demo version very soon.

notes.title: Extended Demo released
notes.content:
[h1]We've happy to announce a new longer demo.[/h1]

Our new longer demo is out. It has now some actual first Exit Door game play in it. See the actual game and live some of it's magic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43689416/ee236d0006772048dec706530a32af0d4965d9d3.jpg[/img]

Meet new characters with their just recorded voices. We've ahead of our schedule with the speech recordings!
